title: QIDI's ADB root shell off (anyone on the network could get root on the printer without a password)
note: QIDI's Rockchip system image starts Android Debug Bridge (adbd) through Rockchip's usbdevice.service. On the Q2 02.04 adbd runs as root and listens on TCP port 5555 on every network interface (ADB_TCP_PORT=5555, shell /bin/bash), so any device on the printer's network can get a root shell without a password. The service sets up only the ADB USB function (checked on the printer: /var/run/.usbdevice = adb). The installer stops and disables it; if the printer has no such service, nothing is done. QIDI's updates, recovery and reflash do not use ADB. Uninstall turns it back on (QIDI's state).
